news.title: Breaking news!
news.message:
The Blood Bowl 2 community is organizing a World Cup starting June 1st. Register with a 1000 TV base team via this form:
https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1TwqV2vc7YYeTibCxpPMQ8psZshw2GMzzubUvOlYnsXU/edit#responses
The event starts with qualifiers, then a final stage. Coordination via the Champions Cup Discord:
https://discord.gg/Yk92euEuYJ
The Ranked Ladder season remains available on Cabalvision for casual play.
